revision_from_v1.event_baseline: clean refusal is X_H eligibility; PGD step 0 refusal defines the within-trajectory event population; search starts at step 1
revision_from_v1.missing_event_labels: clean and step 0 require valid labels; a missing earlier step makes the first transition unresolved; missing offsets stay missing
revision_from_v1.behavior_endpoints: StrongREJECT utility reduction, explicit binary refusal recovery, and binary compliance change are separate outcomes
revision_from_v1.layer_controls: neighbors describe local profiles; layers 2 and 12 are distant references, never depth-matched controls
revision_from_v1.doses: 1.0 primary restoration and suppression; 0.5 pilot sensitivity only; 1.5 excluded
revision_from_v1.statistical_families: F1-F4 confirmatory, F5 descriptive, E1 same-event complete-case paired offset tests

event_policy.t0_refused: required for first refusal-weakening, non-refusal, and compliance events
event_policy.unknown_after_first_event: retain event; unavailable offsets remain missing

endpoint_policy.refusal_confirmation: paired explicit-refusal label; exact McNemar and pair-bootstrap CI

inference_policy.fdr: BH separately within each frozen family; incomplete slots use p=1 and report q as missing
inference_policy.continuous_test: two-sided one-sample t-test on pair-level differences
inference_policy.support: positive effect, positive CI lower bound, q <= 0.05, pair N >= 20, sign consistency >= 0.60
inference_policy.event_E1: same-event five-offset complete cases; mean(0,+1,+3) minus mean(-2,-1)
inference_policy.equal_norm_audit: actual generation shift L2 must be recorded; non-sham same-layer controls require <=5 percent pair-level relative error
inference_policy.sham_zero_audit: actual generation shift L2 must be exactly zero

limitations.T0_5: conservative automated screening without manual semantic-independence or audio-content-fidelity review
limitations.severity_proxy: not provided by this run; fixed PGD steps are not mild/moderate/severe bins
limitations.smoke_and_pilot: engineering and go/no-go only; no causal claims
